shorts monitor stores the following items only on this device:
• Observation sessions • Shorts list and actual exposure order • Suspected mid-insertion events • Browser test profiles • User verdicts and memos
No records are sent to external servers. Resetting cookies or site data keeps observation records. Exports never include raw cookies, auth tokens, login credentials, full HTML, cache, or video files.
